messages:
hana (recruiter): heads-up 12; this morning i noticed several interviewers suddenly lost the 'certified_interviewer' tag and their scorecard links returned 403. affected panels for tomorrow.

maria (people-ops): omg. do we have ids or a job id? any recent cert automation changes?

hana (recruiter): saw it after the nightly cert-sweeper job. job id `cert-sweep-2026-08-15-01`. sample interviewers: I-709, I-712, I-718. they all had certs expiring next week — should not be revoked yet.

cert-bot: automated event: cert-sweep-2026-08-15-01 processed at 2026-08-15T01:03:12Z, scanned=824, revoked=7, handler=cert-service-v3

leo (infra): i'm looking at the sweeper logs. the revocation rule uses cert_expiry at midnight UTC but a recent change to the cert-db introduced a timezone-less timestamp. looks like the compare treated local timestamps as UTC and flagged things early (clock-skew).

oliver (trainer): quick workaround: i can reapply certified tags and reissue scorecard links for the affected interviewers. but we should avoid manual work if more revocations happen overnight.

maria (people-ops): please do manual reapply for the three listed. also pause the sweeper until eng confirms root cause. i'll notify hiring managers.

leo (infra): pausing scheduled sweeper now. i'll add a guard in the job to skip revocations if cert_expiry is within the next 7 days until we fix timezone handling.

hana (recruiter): pasted sanitized event payload: {"job":"cert-sweep-2026-08-15-01","revoked":["I-709","I-712","I-718"],"reason":"expiry_check"}

oliver (trainer): ran `./tools/reapply_cert --ids I-709,I-712,I-718` and reissued scorecard links. verified access as recruiter and interviewer.

leo (infra): pushed a hotfix to treat naive timestamps as local and convert to UTC before comparison. testing in staging now. PR: https://github.com/redwood/cert-service/pull/133 (hotfix).

maria (people-ops): thanks. please also add an alert when revocations > 1 in a single sweep and a changelog note for People Ops.

leo (infra): added alert and changelog entry. running a targeted backfill to restore cert status for anyone revoked in the last 24h. job id `cert-backfill-2790123600`. ETA ~10m.

cert-bot: backfill job cert-backfill-2790123600 started at 2026-08-15T01:25:00Z, target=7

leo (infra): backfill complete 12; restored 7 certs and reissued links. rolling the hotfix to prod after a short smoke test.

maria (people-ops): verified with hiring managers 12; panels are OK. scheduling a 15m retro tomorrow to update the cert runbook: add timezone checks, alerting, and a manual unrevocation play.

hana (recruiter): can we also add a pre-sweep dry-run email to People Ops with a list of candidates that would be revoked? would help prevent surprises.

leo (infra): good idea. adding dry-run email and a toggle to require People Ops sign-off for sweeps that revoke >5 certs. adding unit tests too. PR updated: https://github.com/redwood/cert-service/pull/133 (wip).

oliver (trainer): i'll update training docs to mention the new pre-sweep signoff and how to request reissue. leaving a note in onboarding: "if your cert disappears unexpectedly, ping People Ops before rescheduling panels."

maria (people-ops): thanks everyone. i'll file REC-6148 and add runbook items. closing the immediate incident now. :thumbsup:
